about: Key-input move data for ComboTracker, drafted from encore.moe by tools/ww_build_moves.py. Entries with "reviewed": true were checked by hand; edit this file directly to fix or add details.

aemeath.name: Aemeath
aemeath.notes: Holding LMB longer goes from Charged I to Charged II; LMB after Charged I is Stage 2, after Charged II is Stage 3. E right after Basic 2-4, a Heavy or a Dodge Counter casts Sync Strike: Armament Merge and switches to the Mech, whose own 4-hit chain this file does not track separately.
